request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them). --behaviour

requests.reason: The test expected list(todos) with no options to show completed todos ("[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). The instruction makes the default hide completed todos, so the expectation is now "[ ] eggs". The case that shows everything is now covered by the new includeDone: true test.
